[[File:Neutronium.png|thumb|right|150px|Neutronium]]
'''Neutronium''' was a heavy metallic element used in the production of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] as well as [[dura-armor]]. It was also once used to make strong blades for [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. Neutronium [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] parts existed at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Sith Wars/Legends|conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Hull/Legends|hull]] cladding of [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] was impregnated with neutronium, as its ultra-dispersive characteristics allowed for high protection. Immensely strong transparent neutronium was used by the inhabitants of [[Demophon]] in order to protect their cities.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In popular scientific literature and science fiction, though rarely in formal scientific literature, the term "[[Wikipedia:Neutronium|neutronium]]" is often used for the extremely dense neutron degenerate matter at the cores of [[Neutron star/Legends|neutron stars]].

According to ''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]'', neutronium is a naturally occurring metal that can be found in mineral veins on moons.
